prompt.zh-TW: 小山咖啡這個月剛開業，現金沒有月初餘額。小晴把這個月的分錄過到現金的 T 字帳：借方合計 {{money:vars.drTotal}}，貸方合計 {{money:vars.crTotal}}。現金的餘額是多少、在哪一邊？
prompt.en: Hillside Coffee opened this month, so cash had no opening balance. Ching posts the month’s entries to the cash T-account: debits total {{money:vars.drTotal}} and credits total {{money:vars.crTotal}}. What is the cash balance, and on which side?

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。餘額是兩邊相減；現金是資產，收進來的多於付出去的，餘額落在借方。
feedback.en: That is right. The balance is the difference between the two sides; cash is an asset, more came in than went out, so the balance sits on the debit side.

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道現金的餘額在借方，這部分對。但餘額是「借方合計減貸方合計」，不是兩邊相加；兩邊相加得到的是這個月經手的現金總量，不是現在手上有多少。
feedback.en: You know a cash balance sits on the debit side, which is right. But the balance is debits minus credits, not the two added together; adding gives the total cash handled this month, not what is on hand now.

feedback.zh-TW: 金額算對了。不過借方合計比貸方大，餘額落在大的那一邊，也就是借方。現金如果出現貸方餘額，代表付出去的比收到的多，帳上現金變成負數，要回頭檢查哪裡記錯了。
feedback.en: The amount is right. But debits exceed credits, so the balance sits on the larger side, the debit side. A credit balance in cash would mean more paid out than received, a negative cash figure and a sign to go back and look for the error.

explanation.zh-TW: {{option:o_p4q5}}正確：{{money:vars.drTotal}} 減 {{money:vars.crTotal}} 等於 {{money:vars.balance}}，落在借方。{{option:o_r6s7}}把兩邊相加；{{option:o_t8v9}}把餘額放錯邊。這個借方餘額就是資產負債表上「現金及約當現金」那一列的數字。
explanation.en: {{option:o_p4q5}} is right: {{money:vars.drTotal}} less {{money:vars.crTotal}} is {{money:vars.balance}}, on the debit side. {{option:o_r6s7}} adds the sides; {{option:o_t8v9}} puts the balance on the wrong side. This debit balance is the figure on the cash and cash equivalents line of the balance sheet.
